difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a regular local algebra over a field whose residue field extension is separable is formally smooth in the adic topology. The proof reduces to the complete case using that formal smoothness can be checked after completion, then writes the complete regular local algebra as a power series ring over its residue field. Formal smoothness of that power series ring is assembled from three inputs: the residue field is formally smooth over the base field by separability, the polynomial ring is formally smooth over the residue field as a polynomial algebra, so the polynomial ring is formally smooth over the base field by composition, which upgrades to the adic topology and then passes to the power series ring by the same completion argument.
